runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 18:02 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. LinkedIn surfaced a fresh DHL Express IT podpora koncovych uzivatelov in Bratislava, but public indexing did not expose enough full-detail requirements to promote it safely, so location is ba-area but eligibility remains verification-needed. Porsche Slovakia IT Sales & After Sales Specialist was verified on the canonical Volkswagen Group career page: Bratislava, published 14 Sep, up to 20% remote, but B2 English and 3 years project/release-management experience make it a strong mismatch. Kaufland Service & Support remains active and was reverified. Upwork's newest WooCommerce technical role is worldwide remote but requires server-side PHP/MySQL/performance expertise and already has 50+ proposals. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Verification queue SLA by fit
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Give incomplete fresh candidates a verification deadline based on title/fit and age; high-fit support/e-commerce roles should be escalated to canonical-detail lookup within one run so promising jobs do not remain unknown until stale.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Hard-skill distance vector
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Track which exact mandatory skills create a mismatch (language, PHP/MySQL, Linux, release management, certifications) and count evidence gaps separately from proven deficits, improving ranking and showing what skill investment would unlock the most jobs.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
